description: Conversation execution mirrors selected Python gates; no GitHub check/status publication. Review and regenerate when exact source workflow bytes change.

run_commands:
if [[ "${{ github.event_name }}" == "pull_request" ]]; then
  echo "BASE_SHA=${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
elif [[ "${{ github.event_name }}" == "push" ]]; then
  echo "BASE_SHA=${{ github.event.before }}" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
else
  echo "BASE_SHA=" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"
fi

set -euo pipefail

unit_mode=full
heavy_required=true
reason=main-or-manual-full-regression

if [[ "$EVENT_NAME" == "pull_request" ]]; then
  unit_mode=skip
  heavy_required=false
  reason=non-python-pr-reference-integrity-only

  mapfile -d '' changed < <(git diff --name-only -z "$BASE_SHA" "$HEAD_SHA")
  if (( ${#changed[@]} == 0 )); then
    unit_mode=full
    heavy_required=true
    reason=empty-diff-fail-closed
  else
    for path in "${changed[@]}"; do
      case "$path" in
        *.py|*.pyi|src/*|tests/*|scripts/*|tools/*|control_plane/*|pyproject.toml|setup.py|setup.cfg|tox.ini|requirements*.txt|requirements*.lock|Pipfile|Pipfile.lock|.github/workflows/quality.yml)
          unit_mode=full
          reason=executable-or-control-surface-changed
          ;;
      esac

      if [[ "$path" != */* && "$path" == *.json ]]; then
        unit_mode=full
        reason=root-control-contract-changed
      fi

      case "$path" in
        tests/test_p017_mirror_cross.py|src/enterprise_math/p017_mirror_cross.py|src/enterprise_math/p017_mirror_incidence.py|src/enterprise_math/cutoff_pairing.py|src/enterprise_math/legendre.py)
          heavy_required=true
          ;;
      esac
    done
  fi
fi

{
  echo "unit_mode=$unit_mode"
  echo "heavy_required=$heavy_required"
  echo "reason=$reason"
} >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

{
  echo "### Quality scope"
  echo "- unit mode: \`$unit_mode\`"
  echo "- isolated P017 regression: \`$heavy_required\`"
  echo "- reason: \`$reason\`"
} >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"

set -euo pipefail
test "$CLASSIFY_RESULT" = "success"

if [[ "$UNIT_MODE" == "full" ]]; then
  test "$UNIT_RESULT" = "success"
else
  test "$UNIT_MODE" = "skip"
  test "$UNIT_RESULT" = "skipped"
fi

if [[ "$HEAVY_REQUIRED" == "true" ]]; then
  test "$HEAVY_RESULT" = "success"
else
  test "$HEAVY_REQUIRED" = "false"
  test "$HEAVY_RESULT" = "skipped"
fi
python -c "from control_plane import research_control_bootstrap as b; b.install(); from tools import check_research_common_surface as c; c.check(); print('research common surface: PASS')"

python -c "from control_plane import research_control_bootstrap as b; b.install(); import sys; sys.argv=['research_objective_records.py','audit']; import research_objective_records as m; raise SystemExit(m.main())"

python -c "from control_plane import research_control_bootstrap as b; b.install(); import sys; sys.argv=['research_result_control_replacements.py','audit']; import research_result_control_replacements as m; raise SystemExit(m.main())"

python -c "from control_plane import research_control_bootstrap as b; b.install(); from tools import research_result_records as _result_view; import sys; sys.argv=['research_parallel_evidence.py','audit']; import research_parallel_evidence as _parallel; raise SystemExit(_parallel.main())"

python -c "from control_plane import research_control_bootstrap as b; b.install(); import sys; sys.argv=['research_execution_cohorts.py','audit']; import research_execution_cohorts as m; raise SystemExit(m.main())"

python -c "from control_plane import research_control_bootstrap as b; b.install(); import sys; sys.argv=['research_cohort_runtime.py','audit']; from tools import research_cohort_runtime as m; raise SystemExit(m.main())"
